contents.text: How long does Fabrikam Seals have to report a quality incident?
Fabrikam Seals reports any quality incident that affects delivered parts within five business days.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals
# Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals
Contoso Industrial and Fabrikam Seals agree on the supply of mechanical seals for CP-200 pumps: PN-4471-B and, from September 2026, PN-4471-C.
The contract runs from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2027 and renews for one year unless either party gives notice 90 days before it ends.
Fabrikam Seals delivers within six weeks of an order and reports any quality incident that affects delivered parts within five business days.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 4 Quality
## 4 Quality
The supplier keeps an ISO 9001 certified quality system and supplies a certificate of conformity with every delivery.
The buyer may audit the supplier's plant with ten business days' notice.
## 5 Warranty
The supplier warrants each seal against defects in material and workmanship for 12 months from installation or 18 months from delivery, whichever ends first.
Seals that fail within the warranty are replaced free of charge, and the supplier pays for the failure analysis.
## 6 Termination
Either party may end the agreement for material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
Orders placed before termination are delivered on the agreed terms.
